_doc: Manual corrections to the automatic SAM egg selection (Task 1). Boxes are [x0,y0,x1,y1] in 640x640 pixels, drawn by eye from the review overlays and fed to SAM as box prompts. 'replace' = discard automatic masks for that image and use only these boxes; 'add' = keep automatic masks and add these; 'remove' = drop automatic masks containing these [x,y] points. 'hull' = replace each prompted mask by its convex hull (eggs are convex; recovers egg pixels hidden behind stems/bars). 'points' = extra positive [x,y] prompts used with every box of that entry. 'union' = all boxes of the entry are parts of ONE egg: their masks are merged before the hull.
